summary: Iteration 24 — verified all 6 chat-UX improvements end-to-end. BACKEND (pytest, 6/6 PASS, see /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration24.xml): (1) POST /api/chat/lock/change with use_biometric=true persists, GET /api/chat/settings reflects has_pin=true + use_biometric=true. (2) DELETE /api/chat/{thread}/messages?scope=me hides msgs+media+starred from Alice only — Bob still sees everything; alice details media_count→0, starred_count→0; Bob's counts unchanged. (3) DELETE /api/chat/{thread}/messages?scope=everyone soft-deletes for BOTH sides (deleted_for_everyone=True), wipes /media to empty for both AND strips the starred entry from Bob's /chat/starred. WS thread.cleared broadcast handler is wired (code inspected). (4) GET /api/chat/{thread}/media returns 200 + freshly-posted images. (5) GET /api/chat/starred returns 200 + starred-by-me messages. Invalid scope param correctly returns 400. FRONTEND (Playwright on RN-Web preview): (a) E2E banner visible at top of chat with cream/tan background — text 'Messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted…' rendered above the message list. (b) Thread list rendered avatar Image (44×44) for a thread whose `other.profile_image` is set, and initials fallback ('B') for Bob who has none. (c) chat-header-menu (three-dot) opens a sheet with both 'Clear chat for me' and 'Clear chat for everyone' (red); tap 'Clear chat for me' → confirm dialog with title 'Clear chat for me?' + Cancel/Clear-for-me buttons → after confirm all messages disappear, empty state shows, media_count=0, starred_count=0 in profile modal. (d) Profile modal: media + starred cards display live counts ('1 / Media shared' and '1 / Starred' after seed); tap media card → opens 'Shared media · N items' 4-col grid with chat-media-tile-0…N; tap starred card → opens 'Starred messages · N items' list; both views have a back arrow. (e) Tapping chat-media-tile-0 opens the full-screen image preview overlay (visually confirmed — dark backdrop + close X). (f) Tapping the avatar in the profile modal is GATED on thread.other.profile_image being non-null (chat/[id].tsx:546); Bob has no profile pic so onPress is a no-op by design — could not exercise the full-screen avatar viewer with the current Alice↔Bob pair. PINCH-ZOOM gap noted below. No backend regressions, no react-native deprecated-package issues, no red-screens.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec calls for 'phone-gallery-style zoom via pinch' on the media tile preview. Current implementation in /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:732-745 only renders a <Modal><Pressable><Image resizeMode='contain' /></Pressable></Modal> — there is no PinchGestureHandler or ScrollView/Animated zoom wrapper. Static image preview only. Same applies to the avatar full-screen viewer at lines 748-757. On native mobile users will NOT be able to zoom. Recommend wrapping the <Image> in react-native-gesture-handler PinchGestureHandler + Animated.Image OR using a lib like react-native-image-zoom-viewer.

action_items: (a) (MEDIUM) Implement pinch-to-zoom on the image-preview Modal at /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:732-745 and the avatar-preview Modal at 748-757. Recommended: wrap <Image> in PinchGestureHandler (react-native-gesture-handler) + Animated.Image with translate+scale, or adopt react-native-image-zoom-viewer / @likashefqet/react-native-image-zoom. The spec explicitly calls out 'phone-gallery-style zoom via pinch'. Currently the preview only shows resizeMode='contain' — static, no zoom.

(b) (LOW) Optional polish: when thread.other.profile_image is null, give chat-profile-avatar a subtle visual hint that tapping the initials avatar does nothing (or make it a no-op silently — current behavior). No bug, just UX clarity.

(c) (LOW) Self-test pass for the avatar full-screen viewer with a user who has a profile_image (e.g. upload one to Alice via /api/users/me, log in as Bob, open Alice's profile modal in chat, tap avatar → expect chat-avatar-preview-backdrop modal). Code path looks correct.
(d) (NONE-required) The new clear-chat / media-grid / starred-list / E2E-banner / biometric-toggle / thread-list-avatar all work as specced. No code changes required.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/chat.py:762-817 — clear_thread_messages is well-scoped: scope=me uses $addToSet to keep idempotent, also $pull from starred_by so the per-user starred summary resets; scope=everyone is destructive but appropriate (wipes text+image+reactions+starred_by, broadcasts thread.cleared). Could optionally guard scope=everyone behind a 'is-member-with-elevated-permissions' or a re-confirm token to prevent UI accidents, but current confirm-dialog gating in the frontend is acceptable.

/app/backend/routes/chat.py:565 + 820-868 — `hidden_for_users` filter is consistently applied to list_messages, thread_details (media_count + starred_count), thread_media, and list_starred. Good — no leak path.

/app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:732-757 — both <Modal><Pressable><Image resizeMode='contain'/></Pressable></Modal> previews lack a zoom gesture handler. Plain image preview only. Spec says pinch-zoom is required.
/app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:546 — conditional onPress is fine for 'no image, no viewer'; consider explicit `disabled` prop and `activeOpacity={1}` (already set) for clarity.
/app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:355-361 — e2eBanner is a non-interactive cosmetic <View>; consider giving it `accessibilityRole='note'` for a11y.
